diagnostic.accounting: Reused and fresh are alternative public synthetic diagnostics; joint release is not covered by the fresh-control budget.
diagnostic.boundary: Intercept-only mean weights; established cancellation counterexample, not an attack on PSD ridge weights.
diagnostic.claim: In ideal reals, n*w_old-(n-1)*w_new equals deleted label under reused noise.

runs.inference: Descriptive means/sample SD across eight independent histories per cell; paired excess error only within each history; different cells use different cohorts.
